title.narrative: Trinidad and Tobago Open Source Programme Office

description.narrative: The Open-Source Programme Office (OSPO) project will support the Ministry of Public Administration and Artificial Intelligence (MPA-AI) of Trinidad and Tobago in its mission to modernize government services through open-source technology, increasing efficiency and promoting inclusivity. The OSPO will strengthen the capacity of the public sector to advance the vision outlined in the National Digital Strategy (2023-2026), which prioritizes overcoming bureaucratic silos, fostering whole-of-government processes, addressing inefficiencies, and mitigating resistance to digitalization. Additionally, the OSPO will facilitate the establishment of a sustainable national ecosystem for open-source collaboration, innovation, and multi-sectoral partnerships.This OSPO initiative aligns with UNDP’s Digital Strategy, promoting Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) as a foundation for sustainable development and inclusivity. By cultivating an open-source ecosystem, the OSPO aims to reduce Trinidad and Tobago’s reliance on proprietary software, empower government entities to innovate, and foster a digitally resilient, inclusive society where open-source tools are accessible and effectively utilized.
